decisions.reason: The sensor-module supply assignment does not change the established interboard connector types, pinouts, or matching-pin-order rule.
The existing message-263 MODIFY already records that the standalone LDO powers the full shared 3.3V rail, including the sensor-debugging load, with the stated source-selection behavior.
The I2C sensor-interface change does not alter the LED board, and the message's conditional 5V wording does not establish a definite LED supply requirement beyond the existing SK6812 update.

The existing message-263 MODIFY already captures AXP2101 DCDC1 as the connected-board 3.3V source and the battery-fed normal-operation power path; naming the attached I2C modules does not require another path-state change.
The source Requirement's 3.3V I2C sensor assignment does not change the separate switched 5V rail, whose message-263 loads and 500mA rating are already recorded.
The sensor supply and module list do not affect battery connector placement, orientation, spacing, or mounting-hole clearance.
Identifying the I2C sensor modules and their 3.3V supply does not change the established bus speed, cable length, pull-ups, or series-resistor configuration.
The electrical assignment of sensor loads does not alter the power board's dimensions, mounting, USB-C position, or enclosure-fit constraints.
The source decision contains no BOM, assembly-part-number, or R6 specification change.
The sensor-module and supply assignment does not affect KiCad project portability or footprint-library resolution.
